gold_review.explanation: The exact reference inside <answer> scores 0 on both correctness terms: XMLParser strips whitespace but exact_match compares against the unstripped answer (code completions begin with indentation, so never equal), and token_accuracy deliberately returns 0.0 when response.strip()==answer.strip(). So a perfect completion gets 0.22 (format+length) while a near-miss gets partial token credit — correctness is effectively inverted.
